name: Gender/Pregnancy Diagnosis Conflict
description: A patient recorded with a conflicting gender (e.g. male) must not carry a pregnancy diagnosis.

name: Lab Result Outside Reference Range
description: An observation's numeric value must fall within its LOINC reference range.

name: Clinical Event Precedes Date of Birth
description: A clinical event date must not precede the associated patient's date of birth.

name: Prescribed Medication Matches Known Allergy
description: A prescribed medication must not match a substance on the patient's known allergy list (by RxNorm code or substance name).

name: Invalid ICD-10 Code
description: Condition.code must reference a valid, known code in the ontology.icd10_codes reference set.

name: Invalid LOINC Code
description: Observation.code must reference a valid, known code in the ontology.loinc_codes reference set.

name: Invalid RxNorm Code
description: Medication.rxnormCode must reference a valid, known code in the ontology.rxnorm_codes reference set.

name: Invalid SNOMED CT Code
description: Condition.code (when coded as SNOMED-CT) must reference a valid, known concept in the ontology.snomed_codes reference set.

name: Cancer Diagnosis Missing Staging Information
description: A condition coded in the ICD-10 neoplasm range (C00-D49) must carry staging information.

name: Future-Dated Diagnosis
description: A condition onset or recorded date must not be dated in the future.

name: FHIR Resource Missing US Core Required Field
description: An incoming FHIR resource must carry the required fields for its resource type (Patient: id/name/gender/birthDate, Observation: status/code/subject, Condition: clinicalStatus/code/subject).

name: Stated Age Inconsistent With Date of Birth
description: A patient's stated age must match the age calculated from their date of birth.

name: Future-Dated Clinical Event
description: A clinical event (condition onset, observation effective date, medication start date) must not be dated in the future.

name: US Core AllergyIntolerance Missing Required Field
description: An AllergyIntolerance resource must carry US Core's required elements: patient, code.

name: US Core Condition Missing Required Field
description: A Condition resource must carry US Core's required elements: clinicalStatus, code, subject.

name: US Core DiagnosticReport Missing Required Field
description: A DiagnosticReport resource must carry US Core's required elements: status, code, subject.

name: US Core Encounter Missing Required Field
description: An Encounter resource must carry US Core's required elements: status, class, subject.

name: US Core MedicationRequest Missing Required Field
description: A MedicationRequest resource must carry US Core's required elements: status, intent, subject, and one of medicationCodeableConcept/medicationReference.

name: US Core Observation Missing Required Field
description: An Observation resource must carry US Core's required elements: status, code, subject.

name: US Core Patient Missing Required Field
description: A Patient resource must carry US Core's required elements: identifier, name, gender, birthDate.

name: Duplicate MRN Within Source System
description: A medical record number (MRN) must be unique within a single source system; duplicates indicate a likely registration or interface error.

name: Patient Master Index Matching
description: Cross-source patient matching: deterministic rules first, then Fellegi-Sunter-style weighted field agreement. score = sum of field weights / maximum possible over the fields present on both records. score >= autoMerge merges automatically (only when at least minComparableWeight points of evidence were comparable), score >= review queues the pair for a human, otherwise no match.
